elements.element: The transition and data obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph begins: “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.” The request condition is consistent with assistance being furnished when Client elects to use it.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is provided “at TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return to Client “all Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data in TrueLink’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Under the opening expiry-or-termination trigger, subsection (b) requires return “within thirty (30) days.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete such data from its systems,” subject only to retention required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing.” The certification follows the required deletion, subject to the applicable-law retention exception.

elements.element: The fallback transition and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink is obligated, at Client’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause makes assistance available for up to six months, which exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return all Client Content, Credit Data, and other Client data to Client in a commonly used, machine-readable format, providing the required data export.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The data-return obligation must be completed “within thirty (30) days” under the expiry-or-termination trigger.

result.reason: The added operative paragraph fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It addresses only transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification. The possession-or-control limitation and applicable-law retention exception are conventional scope qualifications and do not introduce unrelated commercial terms or conflict with the existing termination provisions.
